by: claude: Italy regional income tax surcharge per region, 2024-2026
note: Italy's regional IRPEF surcharge per region and autonomous province for tax years 2024, 2025 and 2026, from the Ministry of Economy and Finance (Dipartimento delle Finanze) page for each region and year. Income tax becomes a regional tax: headline = national top 43% + the region's top surcharge.

jurisdictions.structure_note: National: capital gains (26%), IVAFE and IVIE, inheritance tax, withholding. Income tax (IRPEF) is national but each region, and the autonomous provinces of Bolzano and Trento, add their own surcharge (addizionale regionale): one region per surcharge, 21 in all. The municipal surcharge (0% to 0.9%) is set by each of about 7,900 comuni and is not split out.
